title: Lekuka/IDMS input-VAT match in hybrid mode and sixth scenario
scope: Deterministic BP4 reconciliation of each claimed input-VAT line against IDMS invoices (supplier TIN, invoice number, date, amount) and the supplier's declared output VAT, with hybrid handling for unintegrated suppliers, plus synthetic scenario SYN-006 (fake or undeclared supplier invoice)

acceptance.text: Each line is classified matched, supplier_gap, unintegrated_supplier (uses the uploaded invoice from BP1/TAX-043) or unmatched, with the evidence IDs used; matching never joins on names alone

Hybrid mode: supplier_gap and unmatched lines become targeted taxpayer questions and advisory findings, never a denial; a configuration flag for hard-rule mode exists but defaults off and is documented as requiring RSL Legal confirmation

SYN-006 synthetic data with expected findings and expected non-findings (one invoice absent from IDMS, one supplier that did not declare output VAT, one legitimate pre-Lekuka invoice); focused tests cover all four classifications and decimal totals
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: SYN-006 synthetic data with expected findings and expected non-findings (one invoice absent from IDMS, one supplier that did not declare output VAT, one legitimate pre-Lekuka invoice); focused tests cover all four classifications and decimal totals

notes.text: Added 2026-11-06 from the framework scope update (docs/reference/FRAMEWORK.md, ADR-040) as a must-have for the proposal and pilot.
